options_evaluated: Recycled post-consumer thermoplastic (rPCR-ABS) with molded-in structural ribbing
Virgin glass-fiber reinforced polyamide (PA66-GF30) with overmolded elastomer grips
Monolithic unreinforced polycarbonate (PC) shell
Recycled bio-based composite housing without overmolding
decisions.conflict: Material and Design Agent recommends recycled post-consumer ABS with structural ribbing, while In-Service Agent rejects this due to concerns about lower drop and impact resistance compared to unreinforced polycarbonate, and Circularity Agent demands a monomaterial polymer housing to maximize recycling quality.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components as expressed through resistance to stresses or ageing mechanisms
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: ease and quality of recycling as expressed through use of easily recyclable materials
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (h), page 33: use or content of recycled materials and recovery of materials
decisions.chief_resolution: Recycled post-consumer thermoplastic (rPCR-ABS) with molded-in structural ribbing (no overmolding)
decisions.design_action: Investigate the chemical compatibility and mechanical properties of various rPCR-ABS grades to confirm they can meet drop-test requirements when structurally ribbed.

options_evaluated: Threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts and standard Torx screws
Ultrasonic welding of housing halves
Snap-fits combined with structural adhesives
decisions.conflict: Material and Design Agent recommends threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts to enable non-destructive disassembly, whereas Manufacture Agent rejects this due to increased assembly cycle times and labor costs compared to ultrasonic welding.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance as expressed through ease of non-destructive disassembly and re-assembly
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: design for recycling, ease and quality of recycling as expressed through ease of non-destructive disassembly
decisions.chief_resolution: Threaded metal fasteners with brass inserts and standard Torx screws
decisions.design_action: Verify the availability of standard M3/M4 threaded brass inserts and compatible Torx fasteners in the supply chain to ensure ease of repair without specialized tooling.

options_evaluated: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with easily extractable neodymium magnets and separable windings
Brushed DC motor with high copper/ferrite content
Coreless DC motor with integrated non-separable gearset
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends a brushless DC motor to maximize durability and energy efficiency, whereas Manufacture Agent rejects this due to the high manufacturing environmental footprint and hazardous waste generated during rare-earth magnet extraction.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components as expressed through technical lifetime
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: design for recycling, ease and quality of recycling as expressed through safe easy and non-destructive access to recyclable components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (g), page 79: use or consumption of energy, water and other resources in one or more life cycle stages
decisions.chief_resolution: Brushless DC (BLDC) motor with easily extractable neodymium magnets and separable windings
decisions.design_action: Investigate the availability of brushless DC motor suppliers that offer mechanically fastened, non-glued neodymium magnets to confirm ease of disassembly.

options_evaluated: Passive cooling via integrated housing vents and a detachable recycled aluminum heat sink
Active fan cooling integrated into the motor rotor with open ventilation slots
Passive conduction via internal heat sinks and a completely sealed housing
Encapsulation using thermal potting compounds or phase-change materials
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends passive conduction via internal heat sinks and a completely sealed housing to prevent dust ingress, whereas Circularity Agent rejects any design using thermal potting compounds or non-separable components that hinder material recovery.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (a), page 79: durability and reliability of the product or its components as expressed through resistance to stresses
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (e), page 79: avoidance of technical solutions detrimental to reuse, upgrading, repair, maintenance, refurbishment, remanufacturing and recycling
decisions.chief_resolution: Passive cooling via integrated housing vents and a detachable recycled aluminum heat sink (no potting compounds)
decisions.design_action: Assess the thermal dissipation requirements of the motor under continuous load to confirm if a passive heat sink can meet operating limits without active fan vents.

options_evaluated: Highly modular architecture with separate, plug-and-play functional modules (battery, motor, switch, gearbox)
Monolithic integrated internal chassis / single-board design
Semi-modular architecture with soldered wire connections
decisions.conflict: Circularity Agent recommends a highly modular architecture with separate, easily swappable modules to facilitate repair and reuse, whereas Manufacture Agent rejects this because modular connections increase spatial requirements, tool weight, and manufacturing costs.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance as expressed through modularity and use of standard components
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (c), page 79: ease of upgrading, reuse, remanufacturing and refurbishment as expressed through modularity
decisions.chief_resolution: Highly modular architecture with separate, plug-and-play functional modules (battery, motor, switch, gearbox)
decisions.design_action: Investigate standard plug-and-play electrical connector designs to confirm they can withstand tool vibration without increasing the physical footprint of the housing.

options_evaluated: Easily removable, standardized slide-on/clip-in Lithium-ion battery pack using standard cylindrical cells
Integrated (non-removable) Lithium-ion battery pack
Corded direct-mains power supply
decisions.conflict: In-Service Agent recommends a removable, standardized slide-on battery pack to ensure portability and ease of replacement, whereas Manufacture Agent rejects this in favor of a corded direct-mains power supply to minimize the high carbon footprint of battery manufacturing.
espr_constraint: ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (s), page 80: functional performance and conditions for use
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (b), page 79: ease of repair and maintenance as expressed through availability, delivery time and affordability of spare parts
ESPR 2024/1781 Annex I (d), page 79: design for recycling, ease and quality of recycling as expressed through safe easy and non-destructive access to recyclable components
decisions.chief_resolution: Easily removable, standardized slide-on/clip-in Lithium-ion battery pack using standard cylindrical cells
decisions.design_action: Investigate standard battery pack interface designs to ensure cross-brand interoperability and compatibility with common charging platforms.
